title: 2021 AMC 10A Problem 10
statement: Which of the following is equivalent to \[ \begin{aligned} &(2+3)(2^2+3^2)\\ &\quad\cdot(2^4+3^4)(2^8+3^8)\\ &\quad\cdot(2^{16}+3^{16})(2^{32}+3^{32})\\ &\quad\cdot(2^{64}+3^{64})? \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Multiply the product by \(3-2=1.\) Repeatedly applying the difference-of-squares identity gives \[ \begin{aligned} (3-2)(3+2)&=3^2-2^2,\\ (3^2-2^2)(3^2+2^2)&=3^4-2^4, \end{aligned} \] and the same cancellation continues through the final factor. Therefore the product is \(3^{128}-2^{128}.\)

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Multiply by \(3-2,\) which is equal to \(1\)
Each factor then creates the next difference of squares
